title: What’s Your LOL Playstyle Personality?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover your LOL playstyle personality!

questions.text: When you’re about to start a match, you...

options.text: Pick a champion you’ve never played before to experiment with weird builds
Round up all online friends to queue together, chatting and joking nonstop
Jump straight into solo queue, staying focused on your play without speaking
Check the current meta and pick the champion with the highest win rate

questions.text: During lane phase, your main focus is...

options.text: Watching your teammate’s signals, ready to rotate and support at a moment’s notice
Adapting your playstyle in real time based on the enemy’s every move
Tracking enemy ability cooldowns to outplay them with strategic trades
Sticking to your strict last-hit schedule, never missing a minion if possible

questions.text: When your team is arguing about strategy mid-game, you...

options.text: Step in to mediate, focusing on keeping everyone’s morale up
Propose a logical plan based on map control and objective priorities
Stay quiet and follow whatever the majority decides to avoid conflict
Speak up enthusiastically, brainstorming wild new plays to turn the tide
The animations and effects feel unique and spark your imagination
The skin has a practical benefit like clearer skill shots
You picked it randomly when you unlocked it, no real reason
You planned to save up for it because it matches your favorite aesthetic

questions.text: When you lose a close match, you...

options.text: Message your friends to laugh off the loss and queue for another game
Analyze the replay to figure out exactly where you went wrong
Reflect on how you felt during the game, focusing on what you could have done to support your team better
Take a quick break to clear your head before jumping back in

questions.text: When approaching a team fight, you...

options.text: Stick to your pre-planned role, executing your part of the strategy perfectly
Wait for the perfect moment to engage, adapting to how the fight unfolds
Focus on protecting your squishy teammates to keep them alive
Look for openings to pick off enemy backline champions to turn the fight

questions.text: You prefer to play in game modes like...

options.text: Aram, where you get random champions and go with the flow
Ranked, where you can climb the ladder with a structured approach
Clash, where you team up with a fixed group to compete in tournaments
Normal Draft, where you can test out new strategies in a low-pressure environment

questions.text: When you find a new champion you love, you...

options.text: Watch pro player videos to learn the optimal build and playstyle
Create your own unique build based on how you feel the champion should be played
Teach your friends how to play the champion, showing off your favorite tricks
Practice alone in the training mode to master every ability before using it in a match

questions.text: When your jungle is invaded by the enemy, you...

options.text: Ping your teammates immediately and call for a counter-invasion
Retreat to another jungle camp and focus on farming to catch up
Calculate the enemy’s health and damage to decide if you can fight them alone
Prioritize saving your buffs by distracting the enemy while your team arrives

questions.text: You make in-game decisions based on...

options.text: Your gut feeling about what will feel most fun in the moment
A step-by-step plan you made before the game started
What your team needs to feel supported and motivated
Hard data like kill counts, gold differences, and objective timers

questions.text: When you’re waiting in queue, you...

options.text: Browse fan art and theorycraft new champion combinations
Watch replay highlights of your last match to improve your play
Chat with your friends about their day or plan your next game’s strategy
Scroll through social media or read a book to pass the time quietly

questions.text: When you reach a high rank, you...

options.text: Host a stream or make videos to share your tips with other players
Keep it to yourself, focusing on maintaining your rank without drawing attention
Analyze your matches to find small ways to optimize your play further
Experiment with off-meta builds to challenge yourself and keep things interesting

results.title: The Strategic Leader
results.description: You’re the shot-caller who dominates every match with precise planning and unshakable confidence. You map out objective priorities, call out enemy rotations, and push your team to execute flawlessly. As an ENTJ, you turn chaos into control, leading your team to victory with logic and authority, never backing down from a challenge.

results.title: The Chaotic Visionary
results.description: You thrive on unexpected plays and wild creativity—you pick off-meta champions, initiate crazy ganks, and turn losing fights into comebacks with your quick thinking. You love experimenting with new builds and encouraging your team to take risks. As an ENFP, you bring energy and innovation to every game, making each match feel fresh and exciting.

results.title: The Meta Master
results.description: You live and breathe the meta, optimizing every part of your play to climb the ladder efficiently. You study patch notes, track win rates, and stick to proven strategies that guarantee results. As an ESTJ, you’re the reliable teammate who always picks the right champion for the role, follows the plan, and ensures your team never wastes a chance to gain an edge.

results.title: The Team Energizer
results.description: You’re the life of the party in every match, cracking jokes, celebrating small wins, and keeping morale high even when things go wrong. You love playing flashy champions that draw attention and make the game feel fun. As an ESFP, you turn every match into a memorable experience, making your teammates look forward to queuing up with you.

results.title: The Trickster Innovator
results.description: You’re the troll with a plan—you use unexpected builds, fake out enemies with clever misdirection, and turn the game on its head with your unpredictable playstyle. You love debating strategies with your team and proving that off-meta picks can dominate. As an ENTP, you keep opponents guessing and your team laughing, turning every match into a mental chess game.

results.title: The Supportive Mentor
results.description: You’re the teammate who lifts everyone up, guiding new players, mediating arguments, and ensuring everyone feels valued. You play supportive roles not just to win, but to help your team grow. As an ENFJ, you lead with empathy, turning chaotic matches into cohesive efforts where every member of the team feels like they have a chance to shine.

results.title: The Adrenaline Junkie
results.description: You live for the thrill of the fight—you dive into team fights headfirst, take risky plays, and rely on your reflexes to come out on top. You love playing aggressive champions that let you get up close and personal. As an ESTP, you turn every match into a high-octane adventure, thriving in the chaos and making split-second decisions that change the course of the game.

results.title: The Reliable Anchor
results.description: You’re the teammate everyone can count on to show up, play their role perfectly, and support the team no matter what. You prioritize keeping your teammates alive, ward the map diligently, and follow through on every promise. As an ESFJ, you’re the backbone of the team, turning disorganized groups into well-oiled machines that can take on any opponent.

results.title: The Lone Strategist
results.description: You’re the quiet genius who dominates solo queue with precise planning and unwavering focus. You map out enemy movements, predict their plays, and execute flawless strategies without needing to talk to anyone. As an INTJ, you turn every match into a solo mission, using your logic and foresight to climb the ladder one win at a time.

results.title: The Creative Dreamer
results.description: You play for the story and the vibe, picking champions that resonate with your values and creating your own unique playstyle. You love exploring the lore of Runeterra and imagining backstories for your champions. As an INFP, you turn every match into a personal journey, playing with heart and creativity even when the odds are stacked against you.

results.title: The Methodical Grinder
results.description: You’re the patient player who climbs the ladder with consistent, methodical play. You focus on perfecting last-hitting, warding, and role execution, never cutting corners. As an ISTJ, you’re the reliable teammate who never makes a careless mistake, using discipline and hard work to slowly but surely climb to the top.

results.title: The Aesthetic Player
results.description: You play for the art and the feeling—you pick champions with beautiful skins, fluid animations, and satisfying playstyles. You love expressing yourself through your play, making every move feel intentional and graceful. As an ISFP, you turn every match into a performance, focusing on the joy of the game rather than just winning or losing.

results.title: The Theorycrafter
results.description: You’re the quiet genius who spends hours analyzing champion mechanics, creating innovative builds, and testing new strategies in custom games. You love solving the game’s hidden puzzles and finding exploits that no one else has discovered. As an INTP, you turn every match into an experiment, using your curiosity and logic to push the boundaries of what’s possible.

results.title: The Empathetic Observer
results.description: You’re the quiet teammate who sees everything—you notice when a teammate is struggling, predict enemy plays by reading their movements, and support the team in subtle but impactful ways. You play with heart, focusing on making sure everyone feels seen and valued. As an INFJ, you turn chaotic matches into moments of connection, even when you’re not talking.

results.title: The Silent Sharpshooter
results.description: You’re the quiet assassin who dominates matches with precise aim and quick reflexes. You play champions that let you take down enemies without being seen, using your technical skill to outplay opponents with ease. As an ISTP, you turn every match into a solo challenge, relying on your hands-on skill and quick thinking to take down enemies one by one.

results.title: The Quiet Guardian
results.description: You’re the unsung hero who keeps the team alive with perfect wards, timely heals, and selfless play. You prioritize supporting your teammates, even if it means sacrificing your own kills or farm. As an ISFJ, you’re the backbone of the team, turning disorganized groups into well-oiled machines that can take on any opponent, all without drawing attention to yourself.
